title: Desktop model list lives in the model-catalog cache, not the mod API
what: anvil-mode reads the app's picker from ~/.claude/cache/model-catalog/*-ccd.json (greatest fetchedAt wins).
why: The mod API has no call that lists models; effort levels and badges differ per model.
learned: The cache is undocumented, so parse defensively and fall back to aliases. Desktop draws every Button natively and uses a proportional font: one Button per row, no space padding.
author: reactive-end
